heading: PCIe Extension Cable
bottomHtml:
The PCIe Extension Cable is designed to extend the connection between your motherboard and PCI Express expansion cards, providing greater flexibility for custom PC builds, GPU installations, servers, workstations, and mining systems. It enables easier cable management, improved airflow, and convenient hardware placement without compromising signal stability.


Available in PCIe x1, x4, x8, and x16 configurations, these extension cables support high-speed PCI Express data transmission and are compatible with graphics cards, RAID controllers, network interface cards (NICs), capture cards, AI accelerators, and other PCIe devices. Built with premium conductors, high-quality shielding, and durable connectors, PCIe extension cables ensure reliable performance while reducing signal interference.


Whether you're building a compact PC, a rack-mounted server, or a high-performance workstation, OTECH BD offers genuine PCIe extension cables to meet your requirements.
